# BACTEREMIA ASSOCIATED WITH LISTERIA MONOCYTOGENES

Consult Infectious Diseases in all cases. Identification and treatment of the

source of infection, in addition to antimicrobial therapy, is crucial for

resolution of infection.

# Duration of treatment

Treat for a total duration of at least 2 weeks.

# Treatment of listeria infection

[Ampicillin 2 gm IV q4h \($$\) R](psjizid-ampicillin-2-gm-iv-q4h)

# Alternative
